The biggest benefit for me in using Saner is the Proactive AI. Staying on top of the constant flow of email and multiple calendars is challenging, and so far, Saner is the only AI-based tool that truly feels like a personal assistant. Many AI tools can read your email and calendar, but it's still manual to ask for summaries of schedules and get recommendations for what to work on next.

Saner automatically does this and helps prioritize what emails to follow up on, what tasks to work on(either from notes or dedicated tasks), and highlights important subjects from meeting notes. It saves a lot of "friction" from jumping over to another tool when you can just talk to Saner.

It's saved my butt many times, bringing things to my attention that I forgot about.

Have a question?

I don't have ADHD. Can I use this?

Yes! The ADHD-friendly app we're building is powerful (because managing information effectively and staying productive with ADHD is hard)!

If your challenges aren’t as overwhelming as those faced by people with ADHD, the app will work wonders for you.

Why should I choose Saner.AI?

Saner.AI helps you make sense of all your scattered information - notes, emails, tasks, docs, meeting transcripts, ideas - so you don’t have to rely on memory or waste time searching.

Instead of juggling between multiple apps, Saner.AI gives you one place where everything connects
You can ask questions across your notes and files to find exactly what you need, even if you forgot the exact words.
It helps you turn messy thoughts into organized tasks and follow up on things you might’ve missed, without needing to set manual reminders.

Saner learns what’s important to you, so it can bring up the right info when you need it, not when it’s already too late.

It’s especially useful if you tend to get overwhelmed, distracted, or buried in a sea of information. Saner.AI is an AI Assistant built to reduce cognitive load and give you back the peace of mind

Why is Saner.AI an AI Assistant for ADHDers?

Saner.AI was built by people with ADHD. We know what it feels like to have a brain full of ideas, reminders, scattered notes, and half-finished tasks—only to lose track of them when you need them most.

1) Simple, distraction-free note-taking: You won't have to deal with clutter or too much on your screen, so it's easier to focus on what matters.

2) All-in-one research, writing, and organizing: You can do everything—take notes, find what you need, and use your information—without jumping between different apps or views. This way, your concentration stays intact.

3) Meet Skai, your personal assistant: Instead of relying on memory or jumping between ten different apps, you can just write things down naturally - thoughts, tasks, notes - and Skai will organize them, connect related ideas, and even remind you of things when they’re relevant.

We believe Saner.AI is thoughtfully designed to make life easier for busy professionals, especially one with ADHD, who need a little help managing all the information they juggle.

You can read how Saner.AI solves context switching problem here

Is Saner.AI built by ADHDer?

Absolutely! One of the co-founders of Saner.ai has ADHD, and the idea for the app actually came from his own experience of struggling to find something that worked for him when it came to managing information.

That's why we've designed Saner to be really intuitive and simple to use, but still powerful enough so you can get everything done in one place without the constant need to jump between tabs.

Is Saner.AI free?

We currently offer a free package

What is the beta version?

Our beta version is an early release that allows users to experience the vision of a smart AI productivity assistant. We are in the beta phase to actively experiment with the best set of features for our users.

Please rest assured that we are making significant efforts to ensure the product is reliable. We have daily backup for your data, prioritize data security, and offer export option for all your notes

During this stage, we offer a significant discount for early adopters like you because you also believe in the same vision of a better way to manage knowledge and tasks.

We would love to hear your thoughts so please feel free to reach out anytime

How do you handle my data?

At Saner.AI, we prioritize the security and privacy of your data. We do not train, sell, or share your data

Our approach includes:

Secure Storage: Your data is stored in encrypted form on secure servers, ensuring protection both while in transit and at rest.
Privacy Compliance: We adhere to strict data protection regulations, safeguarding your rights and privacy.
User Control and Consent: You have full control over your data through customizable access and sharing settings.
Minimal Access Policy: Our team's access to your data is restricted and only utilized for service improvement and troubleshooting.
Data Recovery: Regular backups are conducted, providing robust options for data recovery and version restoration.
Transparency: We maintain a clear and detailed privacy policy, keeping you informed about how your data is managed.

Your trust is paramount to us, and we're committed to maintaining the highest standards of data security and privacy.

Can I import 1000+ notes to Saner.AI?

Absolutely, you can export thousands of notes that you accumulated over the years to Saner.ai & extract insights from them easily

P/s: we have some users imported +3k notes to Saner.AI system to handle & build on their knowledge

Can I export my notes from Saner.AI?

Absolutely! You can easily export your notes right from the app using our built-in feature

What use cases can I use Saner.AI for?

As an AI Assistant for ADHDers, you can use Saner.AI to:

Turn scattered notes into answers: Instead of digging through dozens of files or tabs, you can ask Saner a question, and it will surface the most relevant insights across your notes, meeting recaps, PDFs, and docs.
Plan and organize without the mental load: Saner helps you break big goals into smaller steps, keep track of what’s next, and automatically reminds you of what’s important, without needing to manually build a system.
Capture thoughts before they slip away: You can jot down ideas quickly (text or voice), and Saner will make sure they don’t get lost. It connects the dots between your notes over time.
Stay focused with fewer tabs and context switches: Everything, from your tasks to your research to your meeting notes, lives in one place. Saner helps you stay in flow by reducing the need to jump between apps.
Support your thinking process, not just store info: Saner is more than a digital notebook, it actively helps you reflect, prioritize, and recall what matters, when it matters.

People use Saner.AI for work, study, personal planning, creative thinking, and just staying sane in a chaotic world. It's especially useful for entrepreneurs, researchers, and anyone with ADHD who needs a lighter mental load to stay productive.

You can check typical use cases here

How does Saner.AI generate responses?

At Saner.AI, we use a combination of the latest AI technology and our own advanced systems to generate intelligent, accurate responses.

This blend ensures you get the most relevant and up-to-date answers to your queries, all while keeping our interactions user-friendly and efficient.

Why choose Saner.AI over other AI chatbots?

Unlike traditional chatbots, Saner.ai is a AI Assistant for your notes, emails, calendars

Saner.AI leverages foundational knowledge and your notes to deliver insightful answers.
We use your notes, emails, calendar as data to give you the most relevant answers
Your conversations serve as direct input for the AI's responses, eliminating the need to manually copy previous answers
You can ask AI to schedule the day for you based on your information easily
